titleText.es: Distancia mínima de seguridad a esta señal: 3 metros.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish title text localizes the distance as a rounded three metres and changes the wording to a minimum safe distance. Both versions extend the absurdity by treating this ordinary wall sign as something people must keep well away from.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: since; from the time when (with que)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Desde marks a starting point. Followed by que and a full event, it means that the event supplies the point from which a later period is measured.

example.es: Vivo aquí desde que terminé los estudios.
example.en: I have lived here since I finished my studies.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: no separate English word; completes desde que, “since”
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Que lets desde introduce a whole event with its own verb. Learn the two words together as desde que when the starting point is an event rather than a date or place.

example.es: No lo veo desde que cambió de trabajo.
example.en: I have not seen him since he changed jobs.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: reset; set (something) to zero (with a cero)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Puso is a completed-past form of poner used with one doer. Poner has several meanings; with a cero, it means to return a counter, device, or value to zero.

example.es: El técnico puso el contador a cero.
example.en: The technician reset the counter to zero.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: no separate English word; links poner to cero in poner a cero
cardDefinitions.noteEn: A is required between a form of poner and cero in this expression. The full expression poner algo a cero means to reset something or set it to zero.
Señal can also mean a signal or indication. Here it is a physical sign carrying information on a wall.

example.es: La señal está junto a la puerta.
example.en: The sign is beside the door.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that a period or situation has continued since an event?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use desde que, then state the event that marks the starting point.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Desde marks the starting point, and que allows a full event with its own verb to follow. When that event happened at one completed moment in the past, use a completed-past form such as llegó, terminó, or cambió. The period or situation that continues appears outside the desde que part.

example.es: Trabajo aquí desde que terminé la universidad.
example.en: I have worked here since I finished university.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: How do you say that someone resets a counter, device, or value to zero?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use a form of poner with a cero, and name the thing being reset.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Change poner to match the doer and time, but keep a cero unchanged. The thing being reset can appear before a cero, as in puso el contador a cero, or after it, as in puso a cero el contador.

example.es: Marta puso el cronómetro a cero.
example.en: Marta reset the stopwatch to zero.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: a safety-style counter sign that reports how long it has been since an incident
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Workplaces often display the number of days since the last accident or another unwanted event. This sign is self-referential: it counts the days since someone reset the sign itself, even though resetting is also how its displayed count would normally be updated.

regions.labelEs: 38 DÍAS DESDE QUE ALGUIEN PUSO A CERO ESTA SEÑAL

excludedUnits.rationale: This is the sign's numerical day count, not a Spanish lexical word.

applications.exampleEs: DESDE QUE ALGUIEN PUSO A CERO ESTA SEÑAL
applications.explanationEn: Desde que introduces the starting event; puso is its completed-past verb, alguien supplies the subject, and esta señal is the thing linked to a cero.
Puso supplies the completed-past form, a cero gives the fixed result, and esta señal fills the slot for the thing being reset.
